title: BRST quantization for the restoration of broken symmetries: a pedagogical example
summary: We present a pedagogical showcase of BRST quantization for restoring symmetries in nuclear many-body systems as a reformulation and potential alternative to conventional projection methods. The formalism is illustrated using translational invariance for a simple system of two interacting masses in one dimension, but with an eye toward generalizing to more particles, higher dimensions, and other symmetries.
